```artifact
Feature: Doorstop Requirements Management Functionalities

  Scenario: Provide unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text
    Given a document with multiple linkable sections
    When a new linkable section is created
    Then each section must receive a unique and permanent identifier

  Scenario: Support formatting within linkable text
    Given a linkable text section
    When formatting options (bold, italic, underline) are applied
    Then the formatting must be preserved and displayed correctly

  Scenario: Support the storage of external requirements assets
    Given an external requirements asset (e.g., PDF, Word document)
    When the asset is uploaded to Doorstop
    Then the asset must be stored and retrievable by a unique identifier

  Scenario: Import content from other requirements management tools
    Given content from a supported external tool (e.g., JIRA, Confluence)
    When the import process is initiated
    Then the content must be accurately imported into Doorstop

  Scenario: Export content to interact with common text/document tools
    Given a set of requirements within Doorstop
    When the export to a common format (e.g., Markdown, HTML) is requested
    Then the exported content must be compatible with the target tool

  Scenario: Provide a way to view requirements as a document
    Given a collection of requirements
    When the requirements are viewed as a single document
    Then the document must display all requirements in a coherent format

  Scenario: Provide a way to view document items interactively
    Given a document with multiple items (e.g., tables, lists)
    When an item is clicked or selected interactively
    Then the item must respond with the expected interactive behavior (e.g., expand, edit)

  Scenario: Provide the capability to baseline versions of requirements
    Given a set of requirements
    When a baseline version is created
    Then the baseline must capture the current state of requirements and be identifiable by version number

  Scenario Outline: Validate unique identifier generation (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given a document with <count> linkable sections
    When a new linkable section is added
    Then the identifier must be unique and permanent
    Examples:
      | count  | expected_identifier_type |
      | 1      | unique                  |
      | 1000   | unique                  |
      | 10000  | unique                  |
      | 0      | invalid (should fail)   |
      | -1     | invalid (should fail)   |

  Scenario Outline: Validate formatting preservation (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given a linkable text section with <formatting_options>
    When formatting is applied
    Then the formatting must be preserved
    Examples:
      | formatting_options | expected_result |
      | bold               | preserved       |
      | italic             | preserved       |
      | underline          | preserved       |
      | none               | unchanged       |
      | invalid_format     | error (should fail) |

  Scenario Outline: Validate external asset storage (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given an external asset of type <asset_type>
    When the asset is uploaded
    Then the asset must be stored
    Examples:
      | asset_type | expected_result |
      | PDF        | stored          |
      | Word       | stored          |
      | unsupported| error (should fail) |

  Scenario Outline: Validate import from external tools (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given content from a tool of type <tool_type>
    When the import process is initiated
    Then the content must be imported
    Examples:
      | tool_type | expected_result |
      | JIRA      | imported        |
      | Confluence| imported        |
      | unsupported| error (should fail) |

  Scenario Outline: Validate export to common tools (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given a set of requirements
    When export to a tool of type <tool_type> is requested
    Then the export must be compatible
    Examples:
      | tool_type | expected_result |
      | Markdown  | compatible      |
      | HTML      | compatible      |
      | unsupported| error (should fail) |

  Scenario Outline: Validate baseline versioning (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given a set of requirements
    When a baseline version is created at <version_number>
    Then the baseline must capture the current state
    Examples:
      | version_number | expected_result |
      | 1.0            | captured        |
      | 10.5           | captured        |
      | 0              | invalid (should fail) |
      | -1             | invalid (should fail) |
```
